• **Another term of the Atomic Mass unit is Dalton.**
 
• **1 Atomic Mass unit or 1 Dalton = 1.66×10-27 kg.**

questions.question: Unit is ______.

options.text: the known quantity with respect to which something is measured
the unknown quantity which is measured

questions.solution:

• Units depend on the choice of system.
 
• Each choice of units leads to a new system (set) of units.
 
• The internationally accepted systems are:
 
 
• CGS system
 
• EPS System

questions.question: What is the SI unit of electric current?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ampere**__.

__
 
• **Ampere is the SI unit of electric current.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Electric Current**

 
 
• It is defined as the rate of flow of charge or charge flowing per unit time interval.
 
• Its direction is the **direction of the flow of positive charge.**
 
• Its SI unit is **ampere (A).**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Volt **is the SI unit of** potential difference.**
 
• **Coulomb **is the **SI unit of charge.**
 
• **Ohm **is the SI unit of **resistance**.

questions.question: What is the unit of work done?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Joule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Work is said to be done by a force when it moves its point of application through a distance.
 
• Work done = Force × Distance moved
 
• **SI unit of work is joule.** 
 
• **1 J = 1 N.m**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Watt **(W) is the S.I. unit of **power**.
 
• **Ampere **(A) is the S.I. unit of **current**.
 
• **Decibel **is a unit of intensity of **sound**.

questions.question:
Which among the following is not a unit of time

1. Parsec

2. Second

3. Light Year

4. Year
questions.solution:
**__CONCEPT__:**

Parsec (parallactic second):

__
 
• It is the largest practical unit of distance used in astronomy.
 
• It is defined as the distance at which an arc of the length of 1 astronomical unit subtends an angle of 1 second of arc.

1 parsec = 3.08 × 1016 m

Light year:

 
• It is the distance travelled by light in a vacuum in one year.
 
• A light-year is used in astronomy to measure the distances of nearby stars.

1 light-year = 1ly = 9.467 × 1015 m

 
• **Parsec:** It is a **unit of length **used to **measure the large distances** to **astronomical objects** outside the solar system
 
• **Second:** It is the standard international** (SI) unit of time**
 
• **Year:** It is also a unit of time

**1 year = 365 days **

**1 day = 24 hours**

**1 hours = 3600 seconds**

**EXPLANATION__:**

 
• From the above discussion, it is clear that **Parsec** **and Light year are not units of time**. Hence, option (2) is correct.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Newton**__.

__
 
• **Newton is the SI unit of force**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Force:**

 
 
• Force is that external cause which when acts on a body, changes or tries to change the initial state of the body.
 
• **Force = mass × acceleration**
 
• Its S.I. unit is **Newton (kg. ms⁻²).**
 
• Force is a **vector quantity.**
 
• **Dyne **is the **CGS unit** of force.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pressure **is defined as a force acting normally on the unit area on the surface.

 
 
• SI unit of **pressure is N/m² also called Pascal (Pa)**.
 
• Pressure is a** scalar quantity.**
